newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Filipino, Saudi for murders.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Filipino, Saudi for murders.

text.p: A Filipino man and a Saudi national both convicted of murder were beheaded in Saudi Arabia on Friday.
An interior ministry statement read on Saudi television said the Filipino man was beheaded for killing an Arab doctor who also held Canadian citizenship.
The Saudi man was executed after being found guilty of shooting dead another Saudi national, it added.
The beheadings in the capital Riyadh bring the number of people executed in the conservative kingdom this year to 38.
Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
